content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a web hosting service that allows you to host static websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means the ability to set up a professional-looking online store at no cost. Notably, this option bypasses traditional payment processors that often impose high fees and stringent requirements. By integrating with NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, charging only a 0.5% fee on transactions. This significant reduction in fees—when compared to Gumroad's 10%—means that with just 100 sales of a $97 product, you could retain an additional $921. This model empowers creators to maintain full control over their income and operational processes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages digital product store is straightforward yet powerful. It begins with GitHub Pages serving your content, allowing you to host your store without any monthly fees. This is complemented by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, automating order processing and product delivery. When a customer makes a purchase through NOWPayments, their transaction is processed on-chain, which triggers an automatic delivery of the digital product. This seamless integration means you can focus on your creations instead of managing a complex payment infrastructure. The entire setup requires no specialized technical skills, making it accessible for all creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms fail or impose excessive fees. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this infrastructure allows you to operate independently, free from the constraints imposed by traditional ecommerce platforms. By leveraging GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, creators can establish a direct relationship with their customers, ensuring that they retain both their earnings and customer data. This model is perfect for anyone looking to break free from reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, which often charge high fees and impose limitations on product offerings.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting for your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of using GitHub Pages for your digital product store hinges on several key components working in unison. First, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, allowing you to easily upload and manage your digital products. Next, backend automation is handled through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which processes orders and delivers products seamlessly. NOWPayments enables you to accept cryptocurrency payments, providing flexibility and reducing transaction fees. Finally, utilizing tools like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management ensures you have complete oversight of your sales data. Together, these elements create a robust and efficient system for selling digital goods.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your GitHub Pages digital product store, first create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Next, design your product pages and upload your digital files. Then, integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing and ensure timely delivery of your products. Sign up for NOWPayments and configure it to accept cryptocurrency payments. Finally, test your setup to ensure a smooth customer experience and launch your store. This streamlined approach not only saves you money but also empowers you to take full control of your digital commerce.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages in combination with NOWPayments. GitHub Pages allows you to host your products for free, while NOWPayments enables you to accept cryptocurrency payments at a low fee of just 0.5%. This method eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors, giving you full control over your sales.
NOWPayments enables low-cost cryptocurrency transactions at just 0.5%.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your digital product store. 2. Design and upload your product pages, ensuring they are visually appealing. 3. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processes. 4. Register with NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency payment processing. 5. Test your setup thoroughly to confirm that payments and product deliveries work smoothly. 6. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a GitHub Pages store?

To set up a GitHub Pages store, create a GitHub account, then create a new repository. Upload your product files and set up the necessary HTML/CSS to create product pages. Configure the repository settings to enable GitHub Pages, and your store will be live.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your digital products. It charges only a 0.5% fee per transaction and does not require KYC, making it an ideal choice for creators who want to avoid high fees and lengthy verification processes.
Can I automate product delivery?

Yes, by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of digital products once a payment is confirmed. This ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately without any manual intervention.
What types of digital products can I sell?

You can sell a wide range of digital products including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The flexibility of GitHub Pages allows you to showcase any digital offering you create.
Is there support available for setting this up?

Yes, when you purchase the Complete Builder Kit, you receive access to all necessary documentation and templates. This ensures you have everything needed to successfully deploy your digital product store.
